summary: PRA Group filed a Form 8-K reporting completion of a $400 million private placement of 8.500% senior notes due October 15, 2033. The notes were issued under an indenture dated October 2, 2026 with Regions Bank as trustee and are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by domestic restricted subsidiaries that back the company's North American credit agreement. Interest pays semiannually beginning April 15, 2027. Call protection runs to October 15, 2029 with make-whole and equity-clawback features, plus 101% change-of-control and asset-sale repurchase provisions. This is a routine debt-financing disclosure, not a special situation.
